name: Club Soda
siboNotes: Plain club soda is SIBO-friendly, but carbonation may cause bloating in sensitive individuals. Consider flat water if experiencing gas or distension.
preparationTips: Choose plain club soda without added flavors or sweeteners
Let it sit open briefly to reduce carbonation if you're sensitive to bubbles
Serve chilled for best taste experience
Check labels to ensure no hidden FODMAPs like inulin or artificial sweeteners
nutritionalHighlights: Zero calories and no added sugars
May contain trace minerals like sodium and potassium
